show: Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: A wealthy new neighbor sparks marital ambitions in a local family.
kurzfassung: A wealthy bachelor rents a nearby estate, prompting a mother to scheme for her daughters' futures. Her husband teases her about her matchmaking plans and sarcastic views on their children. The opening chapter establishes the dynamic between the sharp-witted husband and his anxious wife.
stichpunkte: A wealthy single man moving into the neighborhood is assumed to need a wife.
Mrs. Bennet learns from Mrs. Long that Netherfield Park has been rented by Mr. Bingley.
Mrs. Bennet immediately views the newcomer as a prime marriage prospect for her daughters.
Mr. Bennet teases his wife and resists her demands to visit the new arrival.
Mrs. Bennet stresses the importance of securing a wealthy establishment for their children.
Mr. Bennet compares his daughters' merits, favoring Lizzy while frustrating his wife.
The narrator contrasts Mr. Bennet's complex character with his wife's simpler temperament.

clips.text: Society automatically assumes that any wealthy unmarried man is actively searching for a spouse.
A mother eagerly shares details about a prosperous new gentleman renting a nearby property.
